significance.justification: A verified-true result would license the form-(iii) law that decoded difficulty "should decline monotonically with truncate-and-resume residual work," with plateaus predicting wasted continuation, plus the form-(ii) mechanism that difficulty-head activity causally gates termination independently of confidence. This establishes both a weighty phenomenon—non-contraction marks overthinking—and a mechanism, constraining expected within-trace trajectories, forecasts of wasted tokens, and when changing the signal should stop reasoning; fixed-budget methods such as Muennighoff et al.'s s1 leave precisely this adaptive stopping decision unresolved. Verified false is also informative because failure of intermediate decoding, contraction, or confidence-distinct causality would rule out dynamic difficulty as this explanation, and the quoted monotonic and causal assertions make true and false states determinate. After topic substitution, efficient reasoning alone would not earn this score: the residual-work contraction law and confidence-separated causal gate are specific additions beyond the median completion-signal hypothesis.

reach.justification: The named handles are the "contraction-failure metric" that predicts wasted tokens and the online intervention that reads step-wise difficulty and steers the heads "toward easy"; this is ex ante with respect to further wasted computation because it fires after the answer is effectively complete but before the unnecessary continuation. The asserted monotonic coupling between decoded difficulty and residual work is a relation that predicts what should recur after re-extraction, rather than merely a procedure for finding an arbitrary direction, although reliance on final-layer difficulty heads limits confidence in transfer beyond similar autoregressive language-model architectures. The hypothesis is phrased for LLMs and multiple reasoning-task classes, and its downstream users include decoding and deployment practitioners who can gate token expenditure, latency, and serving cost rather than only researchers explaining completed traces. Topic substitution would leave only generic efficient-reasoning relevance and would not justify this score; the usable lead time, transferable contraction relation, and explicit stopping intervention supply the additional reach.
